verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core model is delegating goals to an AI agent. You give a natural-language prompt and starting URL, and run tasks from the dashboard. It also ships an in-product Copilot chat for building and debugging workflows, plus SOP upload that turns a plain-English process into a workflow. Hands-on reports say it does well on the happy path but struggles on unfamiliar flows such as costcotravel. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on the Copilot assistant's capabilities (a single one-line mention), independent hands-on corroboration of the built-in assistant, and evidence of reliable delegation beyond happy paths.
